title: Existence of normalized ordinary finite pullback
statement: Let (C,J) and (C′,J′) be small sites and let L : Sh(J, Type u) → Sh(J′, Type u) have right adjoint V and preserve finite limits. Let F : InverseImageData L be the supplied data of [def-pur-constant-coefficient-inverse-image-data], and use ordinary scalar extension and insertion from [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data, def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus]. For every commutative ring A, ideal I and n : ℕ, there is an isomorphism e : pull F (constantMap F A) ⋙ change (quotient J′ A I n) ≅ change (quotient J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A/I^(n+1))) whose hom, after pullInsertion and quotient insertion, equals L.map (insertion (quotient J A I n)) followed by finite pullInsertion. This is the unchanged theorem ordinaryFinitePull_exists, without assuming the parent completion-equivalence theorem.

proof.text: The natural restriction-of-scalars comparison is an isomorphism on underlying sheaves. Take its mate under the normalized inverse-image adjunctions. Its underlying map is the composite of the two direct-image comparison isomorphisms, hence is invertible. By conjugacy, its scalar-extension mate is invertible as well. The mate unit equation gives the normalized inverse-image/scalar-extension comparison.

Uniqueness of left adjoints gives a normalized isomorphism for two successive scalar extensions. Apply this twice to the naturality square for the constant ring isomorphism and the quotient map. Whisker and compose with the preceding inverse-image/scalar-extension isomorphism. Its insertion equation follows by the three normalization equations and naturality of the scalar-extension unit.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFinitePull_exists
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : pull F (constantMap F A) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n) ≅
        change (quotient J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))),
      ∀ M : Mod (constant J A),
        pullInsertion F (constantMap F A) M ≫
            insertion (quotient J' A I n) ((pull F (constantMap F A)).obj M) ≫
            (underlying (finite J' A I n)).map (e.hom.app M) =
          L.map (insertion (quotient J A I n) M) ≫
            pullInsertion F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))
              ((change (quotient J A I n)).obj M)
